thread:
mira: Hey team — starting a mini-PRD thread for the embeddings/rerank migration ask from Contoso. They need to change their upstream embedder from dim=1024 -> 768 with zero downtime and no rerank regressions. I sketched goals + acceptance criteria, want engineering sanity checks and scope negotiation.

mira: PRD sketch (short):
- Problem: dim changes + different normalization semantics cause rerank score drift and sometimes large reorders. Contoso wants a migration path without a long reindex or visible quality drop.
- Proposal: support a migration mode in reranker that accepts mixed-dim inputs (1024 & 768) by either projecting 1024->768 on-the-fly OR projecting both to a common 512 latent, plus configurable per-customer normalization semantics.
- Key constraints: zero-downtime for 95% of queries, no reindex for first cut, maintain <=2% MRR drop vs baseline on their eval set, P95 latency regression < 15ms.

alex: Quick q: do we expect projectors to be learned (small linear layer) vs deterministic (PCA/SVD) for stability? learned means storage + training, deterministic easier. Also how do we handle batching when a mini-batch mixes dims?

sam: +1 on deterministic projector as default. We can precompute a stable PCA matrix from their existing corpus and ship as a small artifact per-customer. For mixed-batch: pad to largest dim and include an indicator mask OR do per-dim sub-batching to avoid extra cost. Per-dim sub-batching seems simpler for latency SLOs.

pj: From product: prioritize pilot for 1-2 enterprise customers (Contoso + Acme) first. Launch criteria should include customer signoff on A/B results and an automated rollback path. If engineering cost is high, we negotiate: pilot-only (private) -> general availability later.

olivia: Engineering notes: implementation options:
- Option A: linear projector W (1024x768) apply at request time. Pro: fast matmul, no downstream changes. Con: adds ~0.5ms-3ms depending on hardware.
- Option B: map both to shared 512 via small MLPs, so we never depend on original dims. Pro: consistent vector space for reranker; Con: larger perf cost.
- Option C: runtime fallback to quantized projector executed on CPU for low-cost customers.

olivia: batching semantics: implement per-dim queues in the inference runtime. When a batch contains mixed dims, split at enqueue time into sub-batches by dim, run projectors separately, then reassemble. This keeps kernel paths clean. Edge-case: tiny tail batches causing latency spikes — we can allow partial coalescing with a 5ms wait window.

alex: Acceptance criteria proposal (AC):
AC1: Measured MRR on customer's eval set after migration <= 2% relative drop vs baseline.
AC2: No downtime (service remains healthy and returns results) for 95% of requests during migration window.
AC3: P95 latency regression <= 15ms (for their 95th percentile traffic).
AC4: A/B experiment shows statistically insignificant negative rank deltas (p>0.05) across broad query categories.
AC5: Feature toggle & rollback that can be flipped instantly in console.

sam: Edge cases to enumerate in RFC:
- Embedding dimension mismatch when missing dims (nulls) — treat as error and route to fallback simple-text-rerank.
- Normalization differences: some clients send pre-normalized vectors, others expect us to L2-normalize. Add per-tenant flag: `input_normalized: true/false`.
- Batch padding semantics for attention-like models (not relevant for dense rerank but capture).
- Versioned projector artifacts: a projector must be immutable and referenced by id in the config.

mira: Customer asks also included: ability to run a dry-run that records rerank diffs without changing production scores, and a side-by-side reindexless comparison. Add that as launch must-have.

pj: Prioritization note: must-have for enterprise customers with compliance needs. For GA we need automated eval report generation and docs. For MVP, manual report is ok.

olivia: Quick pseudocode for normalization + projector handling we could include in RFC:
```
# incoming: vectors, dim, tenant_config
if not tenant_config.input_normalized:
    vectors = l2_normalize(vectors)
if vectors.dim == expected_dim:
    use as-is
else:
    projector = load_projector(tenant_config.projector_id, vectors.dim, expected_dim)
    vectors = projector @ vectors.T
```
Note: projector shapes need careful layout. We'll implement caching of the projector per-worker.

alex: Testing plan: unit tests for projector math, integration test with synthetic mix-of-dims traffic, and a canary on a shadowed traffic path capturing diffs. We'll need to add a rerank-eval pipeline job that computes MRR and rank histograms pre/post.

mira: Launch checklist (MVP):
- Config flags: per-tenant `projector_id`, `input_normalized`, `migration_mode` (shadow/dry-run/active).
- Projector artifacts stored in tenant bucket + immutable id.
- Shadow traffic diff logging and automatic metrics (MRR, P@1, rank histogram).
- Rollback switch in console.
- Docs + customer-runbook for Contoso.

pj: Scope negotiation: If delivery risk high, we ship MVP as "private pilot" under Dedicated/Private only. GA depends on success metrics and infra perf. Recommend shipping pilot within 6 weeks if we scope to deterministic PCA projector + sub-batching.

olivia: Perf estimate: deterministic PCA matmul ~1.2ms per 1024->768 on p3 equivalent (per GPU call). CPU quantized path ~6-12ms but ok for low QPS. We'll instrument and set a feature cap default for hosted customers.

sam: Security/compliance: projector artifacts may contain data-derived statistics; mark them as tenant-confidential and ensure encryption at rest and KMS keys.

mira: Next steps:
- Olivia & Alex to draft RFC with implementation details + pseudocode and perf numbers.
- Sam to prepare eval script and baseline metrics from Contoso dataset.
- PJ to confirm go/no-go criteria and customer communication plan.
- Target: RFC posted in two business days.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: rerank-service tests failed on branch `feat/mixed-dim` — failing unit: test_projector_shape_mismatch.

alex: noted, I'll take the CI fail now. Will update the PR with shape assertions and a test for dim mismatch.

mira: Thanks all — strongly prefer deterministic projector for MVP. RFC when ready please post link and I'll loop in Contoso for pilot opt-in. :thumbsup:
